title: BIO-MEMART: Biometric-Aware KV Cache Memory for Multi-User LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.08566v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: KV cache is evolving from a serving optimization into an external memory substrate for long-term LLM agents. In a shared multi-user deployment, however, reusable KV blocks introduce a missing access-control question: semantic relevance alone cannot determine whether a memory block is authorized for the current physical user. We propose Bio-MemArt, a biometric-aware KV-cache memory framework for multi-user LLM agents. Bio-MemArt attaches a normalized biometric template to each stored KV memory block, filters the shared memory pool with the current user's biometric probe, and then runs the original MemArt retrieval and KV reuse pipeline only inside the authorized candidate pool. This design preserves latent-space retrieval, direct cache reuse, and decoupled position encoding while adding physical-user access control to shared KV memory. translated_title: BIO-MEMART：面向多用户LLM智能体的生物特征感知KV缓存内存
translated_abstract: KV缓存正在从一种服务优化技术演变为长期LLM智能体的外部记忆基座。然而，在共享的多用户部署环境中，可复用的KV块引出了一个此前被忽视的访问控制问题：仅凭语义相关性无法确定某个记忆块是否被授权给当前物理用户使用。我们提出了Bio-MemArt，一个面向多用户LLM智能体的生物特征感知KV缓存记忆框架。Bio-MemArt为每个存储的KV记忆块附加一个归一化的生物特征模板，利用当前用户的生物特征探针对共享记忆池进行过滤，然后仅在获得授权的候选池内运行原始的MemArt检索与KV复用流水线。这一设计在保留潜空间检索、直接缓存复用和解耦位置编码的同时，为共享KV记忆增加了物理用户级别的访问控制。我们在拥有者和非拥有者查询条件下，使用面部和（摘要在此处截断）对Bio-MemArt在长期对话问答任务上进行了评估。
tldr: Bio-MemArt通过为每个KV缓存记忆块附加生物特征模板，并用当前用户的生物特征探针过滤共享记忆池，在多用户LLM智能体中实现了基于物理身份的KV记忆访问控制。
en_tdlr: Bio-MemArt enables physical-user access control in multi-user LLM agents by attaching biometric templates to KV cache memory blocks and filtering the shared memory pool with the current user's biometric probe.
